authoritative_source: The test function TestREQ5_S14_DiffThenClassifyEndToEnd itself (identified by name, not line number) is and remains the single source of truth for where S14 lives.
evidence: This PR moved S14's body to start at line 183 (it now follows S13, whose body grew).
